sessionFiles.vibe-home/config.toml:
active_model = "probe"
enable_auto_update = false
enable_telemetry = false

[[providers]]
name = "probe"
api_base = "${MOCK_LLM_URL}"
api_key_env_var = "PROBE_API_KEY"
api_style = "openai"
backend = "generic"

[[models]]
name = "probe-model"
provider = "probe"
alias = "probe"

notes: VIBE_HOME relocates vibe's config dir into the probe workspace; config.toml defines a generic/openai provider pointed at the mock LLM with a probe model alias, and .env supplies the referenced key. No Mistral account sign-in needed.
